name: Digital Edge Seoul SEL1
notes: Carrier-neutral facility at 646/646-1 Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu; Data Center Map lists 2.4 MW and PeeringDB confirms the Gangnam-gu address.

name: KT Gangnam IDC
notes: Listed colocation/IDC facility at 517 Eonju-ro, Gangnam-gu; capacity not disclosed in accessible public sources.

name: LG Uplus Nonhyeon Center
notes: LG Uplus legacy Nonhyeon data center in Gangnam-gu; Baxtel says first phase opened in 1998. Public capacity not found.

name: KINX Dogok IDC (DG)
notes: KINX official data-center page lists IDC Dogok at 5F, Daelim Acrotel, 13 Eonju-ro 30-gil, Gangnam-gu. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Moack Data Center
notes: Colocation facility listed at 553-3 Dogok-dong, Gangnam-gu; capacity not found in accessible sources.

name: STT Seoul 1
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres / Hyosung Heavy Industries JV
notes: Official STT GDC announcement places STT Seoul 1 in Gasan-dong, Geumcheon-gu, with about 40,000 sqm GFA, up to 30 MW IT load, and full commercial operations from June 2026.

name: K-Square Data Centre Gasan
notes: Koramco history confirms K-Square Data Center Gasan development; DCD reports 41,215 sqm completion expected summer 2025; Cushman & Wakefield 1H 2025 marketbeat lists 26 MW in Geumcheon.

name: KT Cloud Gasan IDC / Gasan Iwill Data Centre
notes: Trade and marketbeat sources describe KT Cloud's Geumcheon/Gasan hyperscale IDC as 10 above-ground and five basement floors, 100,000-plus server capacity, and 13 MW initial / 26 MW total IT load. No firm public completion confirmation found, so status remains construction.

name: DCI Seoul 01 / DCI SEL1
notes: Data Center Map lists DCI Seoul 01 at 459-3 Gasan-dong, Geumcheon; Cushman & Wakefield 1H 2025 lists DCI SEL1 in Geumcheon with 17,371 sqm and 12 MW among key construction completions.

name: SK Broadband IDC Gasan Center
notes: JUNGLIM project page lists completed data-center project in Geumcheon-gu with 2021 completion, B5/10F scale, and 69,088.65 sqm GFA; public IT load not found.

name: LG CNS Gasan Digital Center
notes: LG CNS official page identifies Gasan IT Center as one of its strategic data-center locations; Data Center Map places LG CNS Gasan Digital Center at 189 Gasan digital 1-ro, Geumcheon-gu and lists 20 MW.

name: KINX Gasan IDC (GS)
notes: KINX official data-center page lists IDC Gasan at 3F, LG Gasan Digital Center, 189 Gasan digital 1-ro, Geumcheon-gu. Capacity not disclosed.

name: LOTTE Integrated Data Center
notes: LOTTE official pages list data-center business and address at 179 Gasan Digital 2-ro, Geumcheon-gu, Seoul; public IT load not found.

name: Dreammark1 Guro IDC
notes: Dreammark1 and Dreamline official pages list Guro IDC / Dreammark1 Data Center at 61 Digital-ro 31-gil, Guro-gu. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Guro Data Center
developer: Capstone Asset Management; operator KT Cloud
notes: DCD reports KT Cloud selected to operate a 30 MW data center under development at 166-2 Gaebong-dong, Seoul, following a contract change; Data Center Map lists 19.8 MW IT capacity, so 30 MW is likely total/project capacity.

name: Epsilon Global Hubs - Seoul
notes: Epsilon and Datacenters.com place Epsilon's South Korea colocation/cloud-connect presence at 61 Digital-ro 31-gil, Guro-gu, colocated with Dreammark1; capacity not disclosed.
